claim: *Assurance across models and realization.* Claims may depend on modeled properties, realized properties, or correspondence between the two. Traceability and Alignment connect the required evidence.
topology:
An obligation becomes an assurance claim. Establishing the claim can require evidence about
    modeled properties — architecture, behavior, data flow, access policy, invariants — about the realization —
    implementation, tests, static analysis, runtime evidence, memory safety — or about the correspondence between
    them, which traceability and Alignment supply. The combined evidence and argument establishes the claim.
required_terms: MODEL EVIDENCE architecture · behavior data flow · access policy invariants
REALIZATION EVIDENCE implementation · tests static analysis · runtime evidence memory safety
